g.text: 2. Real panels gain less than the simple model predicts
RECORDED RESPONSES + MODEL | Solid: exact observed-pool majority accuracy. Dashed: iid model matched to single-rater accuracy.
Shading: pointwise 95% resampling intervals where supported; the city curve is descriptive.
NBA: 11-wave bootstrap. Birds: truth-stratified image bootstrap. All intervals condition on the recorded people.
City view stops at k=31; all 1,000 items support k=97 (appendix). Gaps can reflect task difficulty, voter differences and sampling, not only dependence.
